# AnimalBotProxy

Kind: component · Defined in [`src/logic/animals/steer.h`](../../../src/logic/animals/steer.h) · Described in `data/animals.json`

The host's stand-in for the physical animal of a world: a Transform at its trunk and an AnimalPose of its ragdoll.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `world` | `int` | Index of the world in Worlds. |
| `species` | `int` | Index in the library, -1 when not in it. |
| `walk_speed` | `float` | m/s of the body's walk. |
| `top_speed` | `float` | m/s of the fastest order its policy was trained with. |

## Notes

One per world, made and destroyed by AnimalBotSteer; Mountables / Mounting make it rideable. SteeredWalk excludes it.

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: Mountables, SteeredWalk. Written by: AnimalBotSteer. Created by: AnimalBotSteer. Destroyed by: AnimalBotSteer.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [AnimalBotSteer](../systems/AnimalBotSteer.md) | system | Host | **write+create** | tick | One per world, filled at creation. |
| [AnimalBotSteer](../systems/AnimalBotSteer.md) | system | Host | **destroy** | finish | Proxies destroyed with their entity. |
| [Mountables](../systems/Mountables.md) | system | Host | **read** | preinit (storage), tick | species and the walk / top speeds of a physical animal's policy |
| [SteeredWalk](../systems/SteeredWalk.md) | system | Host | **read** | tick (exclude) | Proxies of physical animals are left to AnimalBotSteer. |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[AnimalBotSteer](../systems/AnimalBotSteer.md)**
  - Creates one proxy entity per world with a built animal, destroys them in finish.
  - Writes into other registries: the AnimalBot command of each world, read at the next world step.
- **[Mountables](../systems/Mountables.md)**
  - Connects `on_destroy<Mountable>` in preinit (disconnected in finish).
  - Reads the species' skin geometry (`resources/animals/species/<id>.bin`) once per species, runs `analyseGait` on its walk clip.
  - Creates a collider entity per Mountable within `range` of a Rider (or ridden) and destroys it when none is.
  - Logs once per species: `Mountables : <id>, saddle <h> m up on <joint>, walks <v> m/s, runs <v> m/s` (info), or a warning when the geometry cannot be read.
- **[SteeredWalk](../systems/SteeredWalk.md)**
  - Adds and removes the SteeredWalk component, which Herds watches to let go of and take back its members.
  - Queries the ground field per walking animal per tick.
